t: This is Darul Hadis Latifiah, an Islamic private school for boys, with a sixth form, in Bethnal Green. It began in 1978 as a madrasa, founded by parents and community leaders under the guidance of Abdul Latif Chowdhury Fultali, and it became a secondary school in 1999. Fultali, a Bangladeshi Islamic scholar, wrote in Arabic, Bengali and Urdu, and his books are used in studies under the Bangladesh Madrasah Education Board. He also founded several organisations in Bangladesh and the United Kingdom.
